name: Mi Primer Amor
source:
Live a sweet and endearing story! Become the eyes, mind, and heart of Haruto, a teenager about to discover love in a small town where everyone knows each other.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4116190/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
讲述一个甜蜜又可爱的故事！成为Haruto的眼睛、思想和心灵，Haruto是一个即将在一个人人都认识的小镇上发现爱情的青少年。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4116190/]Steam[/url]]
